$comment: Shared kei.tool-manifest/v3 loader fixtures. See README.md for the loader contract. Paths are relative to this file.

valid.name: minimal
valid.description: One harness tool with only the required fields; enabled is omitted and defaults to true.

valid.name: full
valid.description: One connector tool with every field set, including model parameters and resource types with and without parent_type.

valid.name: multiple-tools
valid.description: Three tools sorted by name, mixing both route kinds; one is disabled.

valid.name: operation-class-read
valid.description: operation_class read on a connector route.

valid.name: operation-class-write
valid.description: operation_class write on a connector route.

valid.name: harness-executor-routes
valid.description: harness_executor routes for several executors, read and write, no connector-only fields.

valid.name: unicode-descriptions
valid.description: Non-ASCII descriptions (accents, CJK, emoji, right-to-left, combining marks) load and round-trip unchanged.

valid.name: empty-tools
valid.description: A manifest with no tools loads as an empty list.

invalid.name: not-json
invalid.defect: The file is not valid JSON.

invalid.name: trailing-content
invalid.defect: A second JSON value follows the manifest object.

invalid.name: top-level-array
invalid.defect: The document is a JSON array, not an object.

invalid.name: wrong-schema-id
invalid.defect: schema is kei.tool-manifest/v2.

invalid.name: missing-schema
invalid.defect: The schema field is absent.

invalid.name: unknown-top-level-field
invalid.defect: The manifest object has a field outside the contract.

invalid.name: unknown-tool-field
invalid.defect: A tool has a field outside the contract (input_schema; the wire name is parameters).

invalid.name: legacy-tool-field
invalid.defect: A tool has the legacy permission field, which kei-proxy still tolerates but this contract rejects.

invalid.name: unknown-route-kind
invalid.defect: The route names a kind other than harness_executor or connector_binding.

invalid.name: missing-tools
invalid.defect: The tools field is absent.

invalid.name: tools-not-array
invalid.defect: tools is an object, not an array.

invalid.name: missing-name
invalid.defect: A tool has no name.

invalid.name: empty-name
invalid.defect: A tool name is the empty string.

invalid.name: name-not-string
invalid.defect: A tool name is a number.

invalid.name: missing-description
invalid.defect: A tool has no description.

invalid.name: missing-service
invalid.defect: A tool has no service.

invalid.name: missing-source
invalid.defect: A tool has no source.

invalid.name: missing-operation-class
invalid.defect: A tool has no operation_class.

invalid.name: bad-operation-class
invalid.defect: operation_class is delete; only read and write are allowed.

invalid.name: operation-class-wrong-case
invalid.defect: operation_class is Read; values are case-sensitive.

invalid.name: duplicate-tool-name
invalid.defect: Two tools share the name codex.shell.

invalid.name: missing-route
invalid.defect: A tool has no route.

invalid.name: route-not-object
invalid.defect: route is a string.

invalid.name: route-empty
invalid.defect: route has no route kind.

invalid.name: route-both-kinds
invalid.defect: route has both harness_executor and connector_binding.

invalid.name: harness-missing-registration
invalid.defect: harness_executor has an empty registration.

invalid.name: harness-with-connector-fields
invalid.defect: A harness_executor tool carries the connector-only required_capabilities field.

invalid.name: connector-missing-agent-id
invalid.defect: connector_binding has an empty agent_id.

invalid.name: connector-missing-capabilities
invalid.defect: A connector_binding tool has no required_capabilities.

invalid.name: connector-empty-resource-types
invalid.defect: A connector_binding tool has resource_types present but empty.

invalid.name: resource-type-missing-type
invalid.defect: A resource type entry has no type.

invalid.name: parameters-not-object
invalid.defect: parameters (the model input schema) is a string, not a JSON object.

invalid.name: parameters-array
invalid.defect: parameters (the model input schema) is an array, not a JSON object.

invalid.name: enabled-not-bool
invalid.defect: enabled is the string "true".
